readings: Join each telescope to its observatory on observstation, dropping unmatched telescopes. Group by observatories.lunarstage, treating a missing phase as its own group. For each group, compute the average telescopes.bandusagepct, ignoring missing values, and the count of all matched telescopes in that group, including those with a missing bandusagepct. Compute the unweighted mean of all the phase averages. Keep the phases whose average is strictly above that mean. Return one row with three unrounded values: the average of the kept phases' averages, the sum of their telescope counts (all matched telescopes), and the average of (phase average minus the overall mean) across the kept phases.

Join each telescope to its observatory on observstation, dropping unmatched telescopes. Group by observatories.lunarstage, treating a missing phase as its own group. For each group, compute the average telescopes.bandusagepct, ignoring missing values, and the count of telescopes in that group that have a non-missing bandusagepct (the same rows the average is based on). Compute the unweighted mean of all the phase averages. Keep the phases whose average is strictly above that mean. Return one row with three unrounded values: the average of the kept phases' averages, the sum of their counts of telescopes with non-missing bandusagepct, and the average of (phase average minus the overall mean) across the kept phases.
queries:
WITH phase AS (
  SELECT o.lunarstage AS lunarstage,
         AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_usage,
         COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM telescopes t
  JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.lunarstage
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_usage) AS mean_avg FROM phase
)
SELECT AVG(p.avg_usage) AS avg_of_kept_averages,
       SUM(p.cnt) AS total_telescopes,
       AVG(p.avg_usage - ov.mean_avg) AS avg_diff
FROM phase p
CROSS JOIN overall ov
WHERE p.avg_usage > ov.mean_avg;
WITH g AS (
  SELECT o.lunarstage AS ls,
         AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bw,
         COUNT(t.bandusagepct) AS cnt
  FROM telescopes t
  JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.lunarstage
),
m AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_bw) AS overall FROM g WHERE avg_bw IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT AVG(g.avg_bw) AS avg_of_kept_averages,
       SUM(g.cnt) AS total_count,
       AVG(g.avg_bw - m.overall) AS avg_diff
FROM g, m
WHERE g.avg_bw > m.overall;
